name: zk-research-agents
description: A 13-agent, blackboard-driven research system for zero-knowledge proof papers (protocol, systems and circuit papers): literature, ideation, soundness budgets, PIOP+PCS theory, prover and circuit engineering, baselines, experiments, falsification (Fiat-Shamir and circuit audits), writing, figures, review, submission and rebuttal. 34 skills, 15 commands.
